## Tokens

- Warm ivory background, copper primary, sage secondary, parchment surfaces, warm charcoal text.
- Instrument Sans for interface copy; Playfair Display for human, editorial storytelling.
- Rounded 10–18px cards, pill controls, soft warm shadows and 200–350ms motion.

## Constraints

### Must

- Keep the Mapbox globe as the centerpiece and preserve real geographic routes.
- Preserve warm ivory/copper/sage, established typography and Movement Fingerprint.
- Use real profile photos when available; otherwise use rectangular initial tiles.
- Make primary navigation and controls reachable on mobile.
- Keep Friends-only, chapter-level Private overrides and external sharing distinct.

### Avoid

- Generic circular AI-style avatars, decorative fake maps and a second design system.
- Oversized headings, excessive empty space, redundant controls and nested cards.

## Decisions

- 21st.dev premium research informed the timeline, gallery/lightbox, bottom navigation, profile grid, location card and map-control interaction patterns.
- My Atlas stays editorial and map-first; Circle becomes compact and person-led; Our Paths keeps the globe dominant.
- Share cards use the bundled Natural Earth 110m geometry and exclude personal photos unless explicitly authorized.
